messages:
Nina: Quick kickoff 1: reorganizing the snippets under /docs/samples to align with the new terminology. Key changes: rename SDK param `result` -> `response` in examples, prefer `model_version` for identifiers in examples, and replace 'cache warming' with 'prefetch' everywhere.

Carlos: Agree on `response` for client param. Can we add a brief parenthetical near examples: (note: `response` is a client param, not the raw API payload)? Avoid renaming API schema fields.

Ruth: I'll run the docs linter and link-checker across the samples after PRs are open. There were a few MDX fenced-code issues and unescaped backticks in some JS snippets last pass.

Jae: Small voice nit: docs UI labels should read "model version" (two words) but code must use `model_version`. Also prefer verbs like "fetch" instead of "get" in captions.

docs-bot: Glossary v2 reminder: preferred term is "prefetch". Link-checker flagged 6 broken links in /docs/samples (details in #eng-docs).

Nina: Plan: open three tiny PRs (py/js/go) that only update snippets and captions. Each PR will include: PR description noting example-only renames, a link to the tracking sheet, and labels: `docs:migration`, `needs-glossary-review`, `needs-voice-approval`. Approvers: Jae (voice), Nina (author), plus one eng reviewer. Target: 1-week review.

Carlos: I'll prototype the JS snippet change and include a minimal unit test for the code sample. Will run link-checker locally before pushing.

Ruth: Please use explicit fenced code language tags (e.g., ```python). Ill comment on any remaining MDX playground failures.

Nina: Thanks team 4AA0. Opening PRs now and will ping when ready for review.

Carlos: ACK, thanks!
